title: Constructible generation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over a field [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $F$ is a filtered colimit of constructible $\Lambda$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]: there are a small filtered category $\mathcal A$, a diagram $\alpha \mapsto F_\alpha$ from $\mathcal A$ to the category of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$, every $F_\alpha$ constructible, and morphisms $a_\alpha:F_\alpha \to F$ forming a colimit cocone with value $F$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. (This is the finite-type-over-a-field specialization of Stacks Project Lemma 59.73.2, Tag `03SA`, whose statement is for quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes and Noetherian $\Lambda$.)

proof.text: A scheme of finite type over a field is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Therefore the existing filtered-colimit theorem for a sheaf of modules on any quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, applied to this X and the finite ring Lambda, supplies a small filtered diagram of constructible Lambda-module sheaves and a colimit cocone with value F. This is exactly the asserted conclusion.

No separate proof is given.

lean.statement: theorem constructibleGeneration_finiteType {K : Type u} [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) : ∃ (A : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory A) (_ : IsFiltered A) (D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)), (∀ a : A, Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf (D.obj a)) ∧ ∃ ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const A).obj F, Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι))

reviewed_lean.note: field K + f:X⟶Spec K with LocallyOfFiniteType+QuasiCompact = finite type over a field; Λ:Type(u+1) finite CommRing per STATE ModuleCat encoding; F arbitrary Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat Λ); ∃ A:Type(u+1) SmallCategory+IsFiltered (u+1 needed for F's value universe); D into same sheaf category; ∀a recorded IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf; ι:D⟶const F with IsColimit of Cocone.mk F ι; docstring carries proof via lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaf-colimit-constructible
